Chloe / team —

Added a pragmatic checklist and a quick network diagram (see nw-network-diagram-v2.png) that shows the typical flow we recommend for air-gapped installs:

- Initial staging VM inside VPC with isolated NAT gateway for image hashing/signature verification
- One-way transfer path to on-prem install host (sneakernet or controlled transfer appliance)
- HSM-backed signing keys; option to rotate keys prior to delivery
- Optional temporary bastion for short-lived troubleshooting (strictly auditable)

A couple of questions for Northwind before the call so we can tailor the walkthrough:
1) Will you require us to use your on-prem HSM, or do you prefer Redwood to bring signed images and a verification-only flow?
2) What is your expected retention window for node audit logs (days)? We have default retention set in the private control plane but can align to your policy.

If Tue 13 at 3pm PT is confirmed I can book the 90-minute slot and reserve time for a short follow-up with the security reviewer. If you need to move, we should avoid Wed Apr 14 after 11am PT as several infra people are at an offsite.

Attachments: nw-network-diagram-v2.png (png)
